## How to Join
{toc: How to join the community, the streams, and the subserver}

#### Community:
1. [button: Join the Discord](http://discord.gg/FaXBje6)
2. Understand and accept the rules.
3. Start Chatting!

#### Streams:
1. Go to [My Channel](https://twitch.tv/xogue29)
2. Decide if you like what you see
3. Click the follow button
4. [button: Join the Discord](http://discord.gg/FaXBje6) so you dont miss a single stream!

#### Subserver:
1. Join the Streams
2. Join the Community
3. Choose to support me
:::note Supporting Me
Currently there are two ways to show your support:
1. Sub on [Twitch](https://twitch.tv/xogue29)
2. Subscribe on [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/c/Xogue)
:::

## Community Rules
{toc: What to avoid doing in the community}
- Treat everyone with respect.
- Help keep the community welcoming and inclusive.
- Listen to the Mods
- Do not spam.
- No personal information.
- No controversial subjects
